Name: Approve Phase 0 and name the sponsor and steward
If late (decisions): Nothing starts; the external clocks keep running

Name: Charter accepted; owners named in the decision matrix
Platform host built, repository seeded, host connected through Arc
Least-privilege service principals for Entra ID, Intune and Arc
Read-only assessment run and committed
Transactions profiled for applications proposed to move from their data
Change process asks whether each change adds an AD dependency; exceptions to the AO
Provisional target end state: AD retired, or a dated Kerberos island
Options (decisions): AD retired completely; a Kerberos island for named workloads, with an end date
If late (decisions): G0 can't pass: owners and budgets plan without a stated goal

Name: G0 — Ready to Plan
Criteria (gates): Platform host operational; assessment committed; no open priority-one findings; provisional target end state recorded; no-new-AD-dependency rule in force

Name: Authoritative source for each attribute that drives access
Options (decisions): HR system per attribute; a named alternative with a dated exception
If late (decisions): The taxonomy can't be approved, and the whole critical path waits

Name: Attribute taxonomy finalized (M-014)
Dynamic group design tested; enterprise groups and administrative units built (M-015)
Intune policy design complete; pilot profiles staged (M-016)
HR-to-cloud provisioning live for the foundation scope
If late (decisions): G1 fails its HR-feed criterion and waits

Name: Conditional Access design running in report-only (M-017)
Enforce the Conditional Access baseline
Options (decisions): Enforce; extend report-only; enforce with dated exceptions
If late (decisions): G1 can't pass: the baseline must be enforced

Name: Baseline enforced; emergency access accounts vaulted and tested
Sync and DNS Private Resolver designs; resolver deployed (M-018, M-019)
Root of trust for device certificates
If late (decisions): The PKI design and the pilot certificates wait

Name: Cloud PKI design; issuing CA created (M-020)
IPAM covers the platform host and Tier 0
Single sign-on; FIDO2 and passkeys open to Tier 0 administrators
Every High assessment finding remediated and re-scanned
Choose the pilot division
Options (decisions): IT (tolerates disruption best); another division plus volunteers
If late (decisions): Pilot groups can't be built; G1 fails its pilot-readiness criterion

Name: Design review approved (M-021)
G1 — Foundation Complete
Criteria (gates): Designs approved; groups and AUs drift-clean; baseline Conditional Access enforced; emergency access tested; Tier 0 in IPAM; HR feed live for the foundation scope; High findings closed

Name: Device pattern for each pilot cohort
Options (decisions): New devices Entra joined; existing devices reset and re-enrolled; hybrid joined only with a cut date
If late (decisions): Pilot devices can't move; the critical path waits

Name: Sync deployed; pilot attributes, groups, AUs and delegated roles live (M-022)
Pilot Conditional Access and Intune policies assigned (M-024, M-025)
Pilot devices moved by pattern (M-023)
First migrated GPOs unlinked from the pilot OUs
PIM for every pilot administrator (M-026)
Division DNS migrated, DHCP re-homed, hybrid resolution validated (M-027)
Cloud PKI certificates issued; Wi-Fi and VPN verified (M-028)
Certificate-based authentication for PIV and CAC holders (M-029)
Pilot servers under Arc with machine configuration (M-030)
Rollback rehearsed surface by surface
Drift-clean hold (14 days, illustrative); success criteria met (M-031)
Retrospective and runbook updates committed
G2 — Pilot Clean
Criteria (gates): Zero drift for the hold period; no AD-only users and no hybrid-joined PC without a cut date; no unresolved rollback trigger; retrospective committed

Name: Wave plan: which divisions, in which order
Options (decisions): By region, lowest risk first; by department
If late (decisions): Wave 1 can't start; the critical path waits

Name: Wave 1, first region, about 25% (M-032)
Wave 2, about 50% cumulative (M-033)
Wave 3, about 75% cumulative (M-034)
Wave 4, everything remaining or excepted (M-035)
GPO links off migrated OUs after 7 clean days (M-036)
Attribute coverage at 100%; exception register reconciled (M-037)
Every server Arc-connected or excepted
G3 — Rollout Complete
Criteria (gates): Every division past its exit gate; every HR-listed employee with valid attributes; every PC cloud-joined and every server Arc-connected, or excepted; zero cross-division drift

Name: End dates for legacy authentication and NTLM
Options (decisions): A dated end per protocol; a dated, risk-accepted exception per application
If late (decisions): Application owners have no date to plan against; SPN retirement slips

Name: Migrated GPOs retired
OU-based security groups retired
AD-integrated DNS zones moved, except the domain's own zones
AD-authorized DHCP retired
User and device issuance off AD CS; smart-card logon GPO retired
AD-bound service principal names migrated, retired or islanded, app by app
AD authentication volume measured below the agreed threshold
G4 — Legacy Quiet
Criteria (gates): Only the minimum GPOs; no AD security groups in use; every zone but the domain's moved; user and device issuance off AD CS; every SPN migrated, retired or islanded; AD authentication below threshold

Name: Confirm or revise the target end state set at G0 (D11)
Options (decisions): Confirm the G0 target; revise it with what Phase 4 left: retire completely, or keep a documented island with an end-of-life date
If late (decisions): The demotion sequence can't be planned

Name: Retention of AD-era logs and records
Options (decisions): Retention schedule and archive location approved
If late (decisions): Domain controllers can't be decommissioned: their logs can't be recovered afterward

Name: AD changes frozen; final assessment and evidence packet
Domain controllers without operations master roles demoted
Remaining domain controllers demoted or islanded; domain zones moved or retired
VMs decommissioned; final state archived; retirement record committed
G5 — AD Retired
Criteria (gates): Domain controllers decommissioned or a dated Kerberos island; evidence packet in the repository and the SIEM; no production dependency on AD authentication
